== Updated Java stack for exported Appium scripts

Java (TestNG and JUnit) Appium scripts exported from Kobiton now target a current Java stack. Exported projects build on JDK 17 and work as modules in existing frameworks that use current Appium and Selenium versions.

*Highlights*

- Exported projects use Java 17, Appium `java-client` 10.1.1, and Selenium 4 (W3C protocol), with updated TestNG, JUnit, and helper libraries.
- Outdated dependencies with known vulnerabilities, including ReportNG, are removed.
- Test results come from standard Maven Surefire reports.
- Building and running exported Java projects requires JDK 17 or later.
- The update applies to scripts exported after this release. Previously exported projects are unchanged.

For requirements, see xref:automation-testing:scripting/auto-generate-an-appium-script.adoc#_java_project_requirements[Java project requirements].
